intensity_formulas.autolevel: Nonempty: local imin/imax over included samples; delta=imax-imin. delta>0: signed Py_ssize_t numerator=(n_bins-1)*(g-imin), C integer division by delta truncates toward zero EVEN for floating output. Else0. Unsigned output conversion may wrap for excluded-center g outside local range.
intensity_formulas.equalize: Nonempty: inclusive ascending-bin cumulative count through bin g, integer product (n_bins-1)*cdf_count divided by double pop, then output cast. Do not subtract CDF minimum or reassociate product/division. Empty0.
intensity_formulas.enhance_contrast: Nonempty: imax if imax-g < g-imin, otherwise imin (LOWER wins exact midpoint tie). Empty0.
intensity_formulas.threshold: Nonempty: ascending-bin integer sum(histo[i]*i), mean=sum/double pop; output is strict g>mean, cast0 or1 (not255/65535). Equality and empty windows yield0.
